title: Endorsement mark for third-party application
slide_intent: Teach partners to identify the nature of a relationship clearly. A reader needs to distinguish support, sponsorship and presentation from authorship.
strategic_value: A prepared badge can preserve the program’s identity when it appears in another organization’s design.
demonstration: A two-by-two display compares horizontal and vertical endorsement badges in full color and one color. The relationship line sits above the local mark.
practical_value: Choose the orientation that fits the partner’s artwork and the endorsement wording that matches the actual relationship.

content_islands.name: Relationship wording
content_islands.spec: List possible accreditation phrases beneath the third-party guidance at left.

content_islands.name: Badge alternatives
content_islands.spec: Align horizontal and vertical badges by color treatment. Label the relationship line with a leader.

content_islands.spec: Magnify a badge edge at right to show space between the artwork and its container.
